fact: The AI Policy Lab profile (version of 7 October 2026, evidence to 30 June 2026) records no AI-specific legislation, no dedicated AI governance body and no AI-related enforcement action in Burkina Faso, with the CIL as the data protection authority.
title: Country Profile on AI Governance: Burkina Faso
publisher: AI Policy Lab (LawyersHub), Africa AI Governance Index 2026
